name: app-strategic-plan-radial-tick-arc-with-team-avatars-and-steps
title: Strategic Plan with Radial Arc and Team Avatars
whatItIs: A pale grey-blue slide with a numbered Strategic Plan pill, a large fading two-line title, a paragraph, a big arc of tick marks around a cluster of six avatars and three blue-dot nodes linked by lines to three team members with a Step 1 pill, name, role and description.
whatItMeans: The tick arc and radiating lines make a team feel like a coordinated system, and each role gets a simple card.
techniques: Arc of fine tick marks as a circular frame
Thin lines to blue dot nodes at three points
Title fading from dark to light

vocabulary.definition: A curved row of tiny marks forming a dial-like arc.
A group of small portraits arranged together.
A line connecting a central group to an outer point.
